empirical_identifiability.placement_fact: C5P/C5R establish that lower-boundary state placement causally matters.
empirical_identifiability.breadth_fact: At identical B2P5 bottom support, C5R D8 and D12 groundwater responses are numerically indistinguishable despite four additional vertically distributed states.
empirical_identifiability.propagation_conclusion: After controlling state placement and vertical memory breadth, the remaining high-resolution B14 dynamic-head error is strongly identified with the inter-layer propagation operator.
empirical_identifiability.caveat: This is an identifiability conclusion for the tested representation/workload, not proof that one universal closure exists.

closed_or_deferred_routes.reason: Physically motivated cubic, central, geometry-only and existing-state conditioned scalar gradient corrections were mixed/non-transferable.
The bounded interface residual was gradient-component dominated; changing only an arithmetic/geometric/integrated conductivity mean does not address the identified operator error.
Current-state sufficiency was not rejected by the tested ambiguity diagnostic.
L2_IMC/QS1/QS2_COMPOSITE/HE2 are whole reduced representations and did not cross their R2 frontiers; they are not to be reinvented as an inter-layer LARE closure.
FMC/SMVE remains a distinct representation comparator, not an inter-layer closure for the retained Layer-ROM state.

DSE2P.name: Darcian steady-equivalent nonlinear two-point flux
DSE2P.definition: For each adjacent layer pair, retain the current storage-to-representative-head map, but obtain the single conservative interface flux from the local one-dimensional steady Richards boundary-value problem connecting the two representative heads over their center-to-center distance. The constant steady flux, not a selected average conductivity multiplied by a linear head gradient, is the closure object.
DSE2P.conservation: One algebraic interface flux is used with opposite signs in the two adjacent storage balances.
why_structurally_distinct: It replaces the complete coarse two-point Darcy operator, not a scalar multiplier on the existing reconstructed gradient.
The effective conductance depends jointly and nonlinearly on both endpoint states, spacing, gravity/capillary balance and the full K(h) relation.
It requires no direction switch, fitted blending coefficient or extra dynamic memory state.

literature_basis.citation: Szymkiewicz, A. (2009), Approximation of internodal conductivities in numerical simulation of one-dimensional infiltration, drainage, and capillary rise in unsaturated soils, Water Resources Research 45.
literature_basis.relevance: Darcian means are defined by matching the steady flow between two nodes and are designed for arbitrary conductivity functions and coarse spatial steps.

literature_basis.citation: Romano, N., Brunone, B., Santini, A. (1998), Numerical analysis of one-dimensional unsaturated flow in layered soils, Advances in Water Resources 21, 315-324.
literature_basis.relevance: Interlayer conductivity/flux treatment based on flux conservation and pressure-potential continuity provides a physically grounded interface formulation.

DSE2P.relation_to_C5K: C5K found that an exact-steady half-cell operator did not improve the already-fine Reference lower-boundary grid gap. That does not adjudicate DSE2P for coarse aggregated LARE interfaces, where the target error is a different coarse propagation operator; it is retained as a caution and requires a frozen-state discriminator before free-running use.

SCAFP.name: Storage-consistent algebraic subgrid face-profile closure
SCAFP.concept: Retain each layer's integrated water storage as the only dynamic state, but reconstruct algebraic subgrid pressure/face variables so that the nonlinear theta(h) integral equals stored water and interface pressure/flux continuity is enforced before computing conservative interface fluxes.
SCAFP.why_distinct: This changes the state-to-face reconstruction itself rather than correcting a point-gradient or selecting a K mean.
unresolved_theory: A unique zero-fit profile ansatz must be specified without using response data.
The algebraic system must allow unequal top and bottom fluxes during transient storage change rather than imposing a globally steady layer.
Physical admissibility and uniqueness must be established before any response experiment.

diagnostic_controls.arithmetic_geometric_integrated_K_means: May be reported only as decomposition controls; none is promoted as a closure family by itself.
diagnostic_controls.Reference_R2048_T16: Frozen fine numerical trajectory for mechanism diagnosis, not continuum truth.

prospective_discriminator.purpose: Test whether DSE2P corrects the identified propagation error before allowing any free-running reduced-model response.
prospective_discriminator.workload: Reuse exposed C5R R01-R04 B14 histories at R2048_T16; this is mechanism evidence, not blind validation.
prospective_discriminator.representation: D12_B2P5 boundaries [0,70,80,90,100,110,120,130,140,150,155,157.5,160] with exact Reference-projected layer storages.
instrumentation: Logging-only Reference rerun; require byte-identical existing state/mass outputs to C5R where comparable.
At each observation boundary, emit projected storage for every D12_B2P5 layer from the R2048 state.
Emit or reconstruct the actual fine-Reference flux at each D12_B2P5 internal face. All prospective boundaries align exactly with the R2048 grid.
No candidate flux feeds back into the Reference solve.
candidates: CURRENT_LAYER_FACE baseline evaluated on the exact projected Reference layer storage states.
DSE2P zero-fit local steady-equivalent flux evaluated on the same projected states.
metrics: signed bias and absolute signed bias

adjudication.DSE2P_SUPPORTED_FOR_FREE_RUNNING_TEST: DSE2P is componentwise no worse than CURRENT_LAYER_FACE on the preregistered lower-interface moving-phase vector, strictly improves flux RMSE at the bottom-focused interfaces, and does not create nonzero HOLD flux/sign defects.
adjudication.DSE2P_MIXED_NO_IMPLEMENTATION: DSE2P improves some directions/interfaces but worsens others or introduces HOLD/sign problems.
adjudication.DSE2P_NOT_SUPPORTED: CURRENT_LAYER_FACE is componentwise no worse or DSE2P fails physical/numerical admissibility.
adjudication.if_supported: Authorize a separate fresh blind free-running C5U implementation test; no production use.
adjudication.if_not_supported: Do not scalar-tune DSE2P. Return to SCAFP theory derivation or representation-family comparison.
